title: The token expires at minute 20
prompt: Twenty minutes into the first full run, the source token expires. Your client starts receiving 401. What must the connector do?

options.text: Finalize what was fetched so the index is partly fresh.
options.feedback: On a full run, that deletes every page not fetched as stale.

options.text: Skip the failing pages and continue to the end.
options.feedback: Skipped pages make the replacement partial.

options.text: Fail the run with a non-zero exit, leave the upload unfinalized, and rerun after the token is refreshed.
options.feedback: Right. A failed crawl is recoverable. A successful partial one deletes what it did not fetch.

takeaway: Fail loudly; never finish a partial full run.
